# Effective Antruist

> Paste your bio. Get priced in insects, with real Rethink Priorities welfare ranges. A parody.

Effective Antruist is a one-page parody of moral maths. You paste a bio or what you did today, and the page prices you in insects ("HELLO my worth is N INSECTS"), with a ledger that shows where every insect came from.

## How it works

- Spans: GLiNER2.5 small runs in your browser (int8 ONNX on WebAssembly) and finds the food, pets, money, jobs and sins in your text.
- Verdicts: Jev, a typed decision model, answers five questions about the text: caste, moral circle, Skittles for shrimp, doomer, eats meat.
- Price: a deterministic engine turns each line into insects. Default weights are Rethink Priorities' 2023 welfare-range medians (1 human = 76.92 insects); you can switch to their 2025 moral-parliament means or to neuron counts.
- Sources: every number is cited in SOURCES.md in the repo. The spark is Bentham's Bulldog's article "Insects Matter More Than People in the Aggregate".

## Pages

- [Effective Antruist](https://effectiveantruist.com/): the whole site, one screen

## Links

It is a parody. The welfare ranges are real; the verdicts are jokes.
